summary: Micron's record quarter (revenue quadrupled to $41.46B, 81% margins, Q4 guide ~$50B vs $44B, CY2026 HBM sold out) anchored the AI-memory supercycle and split tech in two: memory/storage/semi-equipment ripped (SNDK +21.97%, MU +15.74%, AMAT +13.42%) while memory-consuming OEMs were taxed (AAPL -6.12% worst day since Apr 2025 on Mac/iPad price hikes, DELL -5.67%). SPX/NDX flipped Neutral Bull (trends down, RSI mid-40s) as capital broadened into small caps, industrials (XLI +2.17%, CAT +6.29%) and value; RUT/DJI Bullish. Iran's IRGC struck a tanker off Oman, reversing oil up (WTI +3.06%). Crypto-beta purged (MSTR -9.35%, COIN -5.06%). Only 1 ETF above +3% (SOXX); zero below -3%.
